_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to data/modeler/agentic/worker-config.json after building the image locally and replace image_digest with the image's content-addressed ID, verbatim: `docker image inspect lenses-agentic-worker:blender-5.2 --format '{{.Id}}'` prints sha256:<64 hex> (a locally built image has no registry digest; a repository@sha256:<64 hex> digest is accepted only for a pulled or pushed image). validate_worker_config refuses this placeholder on purpose. The doctor record is written by `python -m modeler.agentic doctor --worker-config <file> --self-test --output <fresh dir>` into worker-config.passed.json; never hand-write it. resources.cpus is also the worker's LP_NUM_THREADS (Mesa llvmpipe rasterizer threads, integer part): the EEVEE observation renders run on the CPU rasterizer and scale with it, so give the worker the cores you can spare (8 of the 16-cpu VM here; the pilot's 2 rendered for 9 of every 12 minutes).
